skills.name: skill_builder
skills.description: Guides the agent through designing and writing a new skill from scratch.
trigger_phrases: how do I make a skill

skills.name: orchestrator
skills.description: Two-tier routing layer. Matches intent against the first-party registry (config/skills.json), then falls back to the 188 vendored skills indexed in config/repo_skills.json. Confirms the routing aloud and hands off a skill name plus file path. Never does the work itself.
trigger_phrases: do you have a skill for

skills.name: brand_kit
skills.description: Builds a complete brand kit element by element — logo direction, fonts, color palette with hex codes, brand vibe, tone of voice, voice characteristics, brand guidelines, core values, and an introduction paragraph — guided by questions, optionally grounded in a visual reference (screenshot, image, or website URL), and delivered as a styled HTML page.
trigger_phrases: tone and colors for my brand
make my brand look like this

skills.name: carousel
skills.description: Generates an Instagram carousel post from three inputs — topic, target audience, and goal — with a 10-word-max hook slide, content slides (short title + 3 bullets each), a clear CTA slide, and three caption options (short, medium, long) with hashtags.

skills.name: seo_intelligence
skills.description: SEO intelligence and decision-support: full website audits, organic search strategy, keyword/search-intent analysis, technical and on-page SEO, content strategy, internal linking, local SEO, and competitive analysis with a prioritized roadmap.
trigger_phrases: why doesn't anyone find my site

skills.name: agent_orchestrator
skills.description: Pure routing orchestrator for the developer agent environment. Parses intent, classifies against the core developer skill registry (code_review, db_migration + schema_design/query_tuning, task_tracking, research), confirms aloud, and hands off structured payloads with run ids. Never executes worker tasks itself. 0.80-confidence threshold, focused clarification loops, error handling, and full audit logging.

skills.name: code_review
skills.description: Reviews code, diffs, and pull requests for correctness, security, performance, and readability. Produces severity-ranked findings (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with concrete fix suggestions. Never edits code without explicit approval.

skills.name: db_migration
skills.description: Plans and executes database migrations safely — ordered schema changes, data backfills, rollback strategies, and production risk flags. Routes schema-design questions to schema_design and performance questions to query_tuning.

skills.name: schema_design
skills.description: Sub-skill of db_migration. Designs and evaluates PostgreSQL schemas — tables, relations, indexes, constraints, and data modeling — with rationale and trade-offs for each decision.
trigger_phrases: how should I model this data

skills.name: query_tuning
skills.description: Sub-skill of db_migration. Diagnoses slow queries and optimizes them — index strategies, execution plans, query rewriting, and schema-level fixes — with expected impact and trade-offs.

skills.name: task_tracking
skills.description: Turns goals into tracked tasks — breakdowns, priorities, dependencies, sizes, and status — and updates progress state as the user reports work.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Fetches and synthesizes external information — libraries, APIs, best practices, market data — into cited, decision-ready summaries that separate verified fact, inference, and unknown data.

skills.name: scraping
skills.description: AI-powered web scraping with ScrapeGraphAI — structured data extraction from websites and local documents (HTML, XML, JSON, Markdown) using prompt-driven graph pipelines instead of brittle selectors. Supports single/multi-page, search, script, and audio output graphs with OpenAI/Groq/Gemini/Azure or local Ollama LLMs.
